title: Minimum Falling Path Sum
summary: Determine the least sum of a falling path in an n x n matrix, where a falling path begins at any element in the top row and moves to the directly below or diagonally adjacent element in the subsequent rows.
statement: Determine the least sum of a falling path in an n x n matrix, where a falling path begins at any element in the top row and moves to the directly below or diagonally adjacent element in the subsequent rows.
constraints: From each row move down-left, down, or down-right.
Return the minimum sum from the first row through the last.
hints: Only the best cost reaching each position in the previous row matters.
Every valid path to a cell ends at one of those three predecessors, so taking their minimum is exhaustive.
